name: mdcs
description: 独立 AV 刮削整理服务（前后端分离）

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "node scripts/wait-health.mjs && npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/server && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/server && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
